nexuscore.name: NexusCore Administration Framework
error.no-permission: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7You do not have permission to do that. &8({node})
error.rate-limited: &c&lCHAT &c» &7Please slow down — you are running commands too quickly.
error.internal: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7That command failed. Ask an administrator to check the server log for id &f{id}&7.
error.unknown-player: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7No player named &f{name}&7 is known to this server.
confirm.rejected: &c&lCONFIRM &c» &7That confirmation is not valid &8({reason})&7. Run the command again to get a new one.
player.vanish.enabled: &d&lVANISH &d» &7You are now &fhidden&7. Players cannot see you in the world or the player list.
teleport.sethome.limit: &c&lHOME &c» &7You already have the maximum of &6{limit}&7 home(s). Delete one with &f/delhome&7.
teleport.homes.none: &e&lHOME &e» &7You have no homes yet. Save one with &f/sethome <name>&7.
teleport.setspawn.success: &a&lSPAWN &a» &7Server spawn set to your current position.
teleport.back.none: &c&lBACK &c» &7There is nowhere to go back to yet.
teleport.request.self: &c&lTP &c» &7You cannot request a teleport to yourself.
moderation.kick.disconnect:
&c&l⚠ YOU HAVE BEEN KICKED ⚠

&7You were removed from the server
&7with the following reason: &f"{reason}"&7.

&7You may rejoin at any time.
moderation.ban.confirm:
&6&lBAN &6» &7You are about to &cpermanently ban &f{target}&7.
&8→ &7Reason: &f"{reason}"
&8→ &7Run &f/nexus confirm {token} &7within &6{seconds}sec.
&8→ &7The token bans only this player, for this reason.
moderation.unban.success: &a&lBAN &a» &7Unbanned &f{target}&7. The record is kept in their history.
moderation.mute.blocked: &6&lMUTE &6» &7You are muted and cannot chat. &8— &7Reason: &f"{reason}" &8— &7Expires in: &6{remaining}
moderation.lift.vanilla-only: &a&lNEXUS &a» &f{target}&7 had no NexusCore ban, but their &epre-NexusCore vanilla ban&7 was removed. They can join again.
moderation.lift.both: &a&lNEXUS &a» &f{target}&7 is unbanned — their NexusCore ban and a &epre-NexusCore vanilla entry&7 were both lifted.
header.bans.ip: &c&lIP BANS &c» &7{count} vanilla IP ban(s) — issue and lift with &f/ban-ip &7and &f/pardon-ip&7:
player.seen.never: &e&lSEEN &e» &f{target} &7is a real account, but has never joined this server.
gui.admin.disabled: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7The admin panel is disabled on this server. Use the &f/nexus &7commands instead.
error.invalid-name: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7A name must be 1-32 characters of letters, numbers, underscore or hyphen.
error.player-only: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7That command must be run by a player, not the console.
error.reload-refused:
&c&lRELOAD &c» &7Refused: &f{reason}
&8→ &7The previous settings are still in effect.
error.use-ban-command: &c&lBAN &c» &7Use &f/ban &7for a permanent ban — it requires confirmation.
help.footer: &8Only commands you have permission for are listed.
error.module.disabled: &c&lNEXUS &c» &7That feature is disabled: the server is running in &fsafe mode&7.
error.unknown-player.looking-up: &e&lNEXUS &e» &7&f{name}&7 has not played here. A profile lookup has been started — run the command again in a moment.
